_source: OSRS Wiki: Bank (bank space, the purchase table) and Banker ("I'd like to buy more bank slots."); rsprox capture of a members account with 2 blocks bought, no PIN, on a Jagex Account (rev 241): the bank's capacity text "1040" and tooltip (script 1495), "Set a Bank PIN to unlock more bank space." depositing into the full bank, the menu_new purchase list (script 9142), the purchase (varbit bank_extra_blocks_purchased 2 -> 3, sound 2114) and the refusal with only bank coins; a second capture (3 blocks, a PIN pending) of "other options", "(Cancel)" and the tooltip while the PIN is pending.

messages.fullWithoutPin: Set a Bank PIN to unlock more bank space.

tooltip.forSale: A banker can sell you up to [slots] more.

_bankerMenu: Live bankers offer the bank-slots choice after "I'd like to collect items." even where their Wiki transcript leaves it out (Ferox Enclave, Shilo Village, Al Kharid). Its lines are the Banker transcript's.

after: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
bankerMenu.choice: I'd like to buy more bank slots.
bankerMenu.ultimate: Why? You don't use the bank.
bankerMenu.offer: I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 50. How many are you interested in buying?

dialogue.offerLine: I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots
dialogue.offer: I can sell you up to [slots] additional bank slots in sets of 50. How many are you interested in buying?
dialogue.menuTitle: How many do you wish to purchase?
dialogue.otherOptions: Do I have any other options for extra bank space?
dialogue.cost: Buying [slots] additional bank slots will cost [coins] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
dialogue.tooPoor: Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
dialogue.added: Your additional bank slots have been added.
dialogue.allFree: I'm afraid not! You've already got as much bank space as you can obtain without purchase.
dialogue.pinHint: I'm not supposed to tell you this, but you can obtain more bank space by setting up a PIN.
